subject: An office that closes away
hook: Hide it all away, or keep it on show?
ig:
Hide it all away, or keep it on show? Two very different ways to work from home.

A built-in desk behind doors uses the full height of the wall for storage and lets you close the working day off completely. The trade-off is that it is fitted to that room and stays there.

A freestanding desk can move rooms, or come with you when you move house. The trade-off is that the laptop, cables and paperwork are always in sight, and the wall above it rarely gets used.

If the office shares a room with a sofa or a bed, most people end up valuing the doors.

Which would you pick, A or B, and which room does your desk live in? We read every comment.
